question: Which numbered procedure concludes this section in the Lakṣaṇasamuccaya?
premises: The section is in the Lakṣaṇasamuccaya.
The procedure is named turning of the pedestal.
It is identified as the eighth procedure.
inference: This concludes the eighth procedure, named turning of the pedestal, in the Lakṣaṇasamuccaya.
plain_english: Thus, in the Lakṣaṇasamuccaya, this is the eighth procedure, named the turning of the pedestal.
